data.name: Hotel Plaza del Arco
data.address: Av. Pino Suárez 935-nte, Colonia Centro, Centro, 64000 Monterrey, N.L., Mexico
data.description:
A 4-minute walk from a metro station, this basic hotel with views of the Arch of Independence is also 3 km from the fountains and gardens at Macroplaza, and 4 km from Fundidora Park.
Featuring straightforward furnishings, the unfussy rooms come with cable TV and Wi-Fi. Suites add living areas and views of the Arch of Independence.
A hot breakfast buffet is complimentary.
